prompt: When I picked up my cat in Edinburgh, the owner smiled warmly. She told me that my cat (to open) all the kitchen cupboards. Before we left, she warned me (not / to keep) fish on low shelves.
explanation_ru: После глагола told в прошедшем времени действие до рассказа передаётся через Past Perfect (допустим и Past Simple). После warn с запретом частица not ставится перед to: not to keep.

prompt: At a small café in Vienna, Lukas laughed over his coffee. He told us that a tiny dog (to chase) the post van down the street. We asked him (anyone / to catch) the little dog in the end.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске прошлый факт после told сдвигается в Past Perfect (или остаётся в Past Simple). Косвенный общий вопрос вводится через if или whether с прямым порядком слов без did.

prompt: My dad loves telling stories at our cabin in Sweden. He said he (can / to bake) bread on a hot stone. I asked him (it / to taste) good. He smiled and promised (to teach) me soon.
explanation_ru: В косвенной речи can переходит в could, общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether с прямым порядком слов, а после promise используется инфинитив с to.

prompt: Sofia was very nervous at the dentist in Madrid. The doctor smiled and asked ___ before the check.
options: her that she washed her mouth
her to wash her mouth
to her wash her mouth
her wash her mouth
explanation_ru: Просьба передаётся по схеме ask + дополнение + to-инфинитив (asked her to wash). Типичная ошибка — опускать to, ставить предлог to перед местоимением или заменять инфинитив придаточным с that.

prompt: The guide at the volcano camp in Ecuador told the film team, 'Stay behind the yellow rope and wear your helmets.'
options: The guide told the film team stay behind the yellow rope and wear helmets.
The guide said the film team to stay behind the yellow rope and wear helmets.
The guide told the film team to stay behind the yellow rope and wear their helmets.
The guide asked if the film team stayed behind the yellow rope and wore their helmets.
explanation_ru: Указание передаётся конструкцией tell + дополнение + to-инфинитив, а местоимение your меняется на their. Ошибки в других вариантах: пропуск to, использование said с прямым дополнением и замена приказа на вопрос.

prompt: During our castle tour in Edinburgh, the guide smiled at the group. She told us a cook once (to hide) a silver spoon in some bread. Then she warned us (not / to touch) the old table. We all stepped back and listened carefully.
explanation_ru: Рассказ о давнем событии после told передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple). В предупреждении с отрицанием используется форма warn + дополнение + not to + глагол.

prompt: On the school bus in New Zealand, Liam sat near the front. The driver told him a brown goat (to block) the road once. Liam asked (the bus / to be) late that morning. The driver laughed and said yes.
explanation_ru: После told о прошлом случае используется Past Perfect (допустим и Past Simple). В косвенном вопросе нужен союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов: подлежащее стоит перед глаголом.

prompt: Ruta works at a busy shop in Vilnius. She told me a little boy (to jump) out of a trolley. I asked (the boy / to be) fine. Ruta laughed and said she (will / to remember) his face.
explanation_ru: Здесь сочетаются три правила: сдвиг прошедшего события (had jumped / jumped), косвенный общий вопрос с if/whether и прямым порядком слов, а также переход will в would после said.

prompt: Grandpa Mateo talked about old computers over dinner in Lima. He told us he (to send) his first email in a small café. My sister asked how much it (to cost). We could not believe his answer.
explanation_ru: Прошлое действие в косвенной речи сдвигается в Past Perfect (или остаётся в Past Simple). В специальном вопросе после how much сохраняется прямой порядок слов без вспомогательного did.

prompt: Our class visited a fire station in Chicago on Saturday. A firefighter told us his team once (to save) a cat from a tall tree. One girl asked (the cat / to cry) loudly. Then he told us (not / to climb) high trees ourselves.
explanation_ru: Первое предложение передаёт прошлую историю (Past Perfect или Past Simple), второе — общий вопрос с if/whether без did, а третье — запрет по схеме tell + дополнение + not to.

prompt: Priya showed the schoolchildren around her farm in southern India. She laughed and mentioned that her cow once (to follow) a bus to school. The children asked why the cow (to want) to go there. Priya promised (to give) them fresh milk before lunch.
explanation_ru: После mentioned и в вопросе с why время сдвигается назад при прямом порядке слов без did. После глагола promise всегда ставится инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: After the market closed in Marrakech, Tariq ran over to his neighbour's stall. He explained that a stranger (to steal) his money box while he looked away. His neighbour asked (he / to see) the man's face clearly. Tariq admitted (to leave) the box open while serving another buyer.
explanation_ru: Прошлое событие после explained передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple), общий вопрос вводится через if/whether с прямым порядком слов, а после admit требуется герундий (leaving / having left), а не инфинитив.

prompt: We sat by the barn after picking apples in Canada. The farmer told us that a brown bear once (to eat) all the apples in his lorry. I asked what he (to do) when he saw the animal. He advised us (to lock) the lorry doors at night.
explanation_ru: В рассказе о прошлом событии глагол сдвигается в Past Perfect (допустим и Past Simple), в вопросе с what используется прямой порядок слов без did, а совет после advise + дополнение требует инфинитива с to.

prompt: Sitting on the sofa in Berlin, Aunt Katrin began an old family story. She told her nephews that their father (to get) lost in the snowy woods as a child. The younger boy asked how long he (to wait) before someone found him. Katrin laughed and warned them (not / to tell) their dad she had shared the secret.
explanation_ru: После told и в косвенном вопросе с how long применяется сдвиг времени назад и прямой порядок слов. В предупреждении после warn + дополнение ставится not to + инфинитив.

prompt: Early in the morning, Claire poured coffee for her sleepy new helper in Paris. She recalled that her very first batch of croissants (to sell) out before seven o'clock. The young man wondered (she / to feel) proud that morning. Claire smiled and suggested (to try) a warm one before opening the shop.
explanation_ru: Событие из прошлого передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple), вопрос после wondered требует if/whether и прямого порядка слов, а после suggest используется герундий (trying), но не to try.

prompt: After our picnic in Wellington, Owen said a seagull had taken his lunch and asked ___.
options: did anyone have some extra bread
whether had anyone some extra bread
anyone had some extra bread
if anyone had some extra bread
explanation_ru: В косвенном общем вопросе обязательны союз if или whether и прямой порядок слов без did (if anyone had). Частая ошибка — сохранять вопросительный порядок слов или пропускать if.

prompt: On my first day at the bakery in Vienna, an older colleague shared a strange memory. He told me a smartly dressed man once (to order) a hundred loaves and walked away. I asked (the shop / to lose) a lot of money that afternoon. He shook his head and advised me (to check) the payment before baking big orders.
explanation_ru: Прошлая история передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple), общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether с прямым порядком слов, а после advise + дополнение нужен инфинитив с to.

prompt: Outside the folk museum in Riga, Ilze stopped to chat with her neighbour. She mentioned that she (to find) a tiny painted bird inside an old clock. Her neighbour asked where it (to come) from. Ilze smiled and offered (to show) it to her after tea.
explanation_ru: После mentioned и в вопросе с where прошедшее действие сдвигается назад при прямом порядке слов без did. Предложение помощи или показа после offer выражается инфинитивом с to.

prompt: Two campers checked in at a quiet campsite in the Lake District. Hannah at the desk told them a hungry cow (to walk) into the field a year earlier. They asked (the owner / to fix) the broken fence. She promised they (can / to sleep) safely inside their tents.
explanation_ru: Событие прошлого года передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple), общий вопрос строится с if/whether без did, а модальный глагол can после promised переходит в could.

prompt: Waiting in the rain outside a university in Delhi, Kavita shook her head. She told her classmate that the fire alarm (to ring) right in the middle of her speaking exam. Her friend asked (everyone / to run) outside without their coats. Kavita sighed and said she (must / to take) the exam again the following week.
explanation_ru: В пересказе события время сдвигается назад, общий вопрос вводится союзом if/whether без did, а модальный глагол must со значением обязанности меняется на had to (или would have to для будущего).

prompt: In our school garden in Nairobi, Grandmother pointed towards the muddy hill. She told us that heavy rain once (to wash) away the old stone path. My cousin asked how people (to cross) the garden after the storm. Grandmother added that we (should / to look) after the new wooden bridge carefully.
explanation_ru: Первые два пропуска требуют сдвига прошедшего времени и прямого порядка слов в вопросе с how. Модальный глагол should в косвенной речи не меняется.

prompt: Over lunch in a Stockholm office, Erik could barely stop laughing. He told his colleague that the office printer (to catch) their manager's tie earlier. His colleague asked why nobody (to switch) the machine off straight away. Erik added that the poor manager (cannot / to move) for ten minutes.
explanation_ru: В повествовании и вопросе с why применяется сдвиг времени назад без вспомогательного did. Отрицательная форма cannot в косвенной речи после прошедшего глагола переходит в could not / couldn't.

prompt: Beside the campfire at a caravan park in New Zealand, Grandma smiled at the children. She told them their old dog once (to swim) across a wide river to reach their tent. One child asked why nobody (to hear) him bark. Grandma laughed and promised (to bring) his old photo album the following morning.
explanation_ru: Событие в рассказе и вопрос с why требуют сдвига времени назад при прямом порядке слов, а после глагола promise используется инфинитив с to.

prompt: At our barbecue in Perth, Uncle Dave admitted ___ the year before, so we told him not to leave the grill.
options: burning the chicken
to burn the chicken
he burns the chicken
him burning the chicken
explanation_ru: После глагола admit используется герундий (admitted burning), а не инфинитив с to. Вариант с настоящим временем he burns нарушает согласование времён.

prompt: Before filming began in Mumbai, Rohan told the crowd, 'Stay silent, keep your phones off, and don't look at the camera.'
options: Rohan told the crowd stay silent, keep their phones off, and don't look at the camera.
Rohan ordered the crowd to stay silent, keep their phones off, and not to look at the camera.
Rohan said the crowd to stay silent, keep their phones off, and not to look at the camera.
Rohan asked the crowd if they stayed silent, kept their phones off, and didn't look at the camera.
explanation_ru: Ряд команд передаётся конструкцией order + дополнение + to-инфинитив, а запрет — через not to look. Типичные ошибки: пропуск to, использование said перед дополнением и превращение приказа в вопрос.

prompt: Backstage at a small theatre in Chile, Diego congratulated the actors after the curtain fell. He told them that a stray cat (to wander) across the stage during the final scene, but nobody had lost focus. One actress asked (the audience / to think) the animal was part of the play. Diego laughed and suggested (to invite) the cat back if they (to perform) a comedy again.
explanation_ru: В тексте соединены четыре модели: сдвиг прошедшего действия (had wandered), общий вопрос с if/whether, герундий после suggest (inviting) и сдвиг условия первого типа в Past Simple (if they performed).

prompt: During dinner at a farm stay in Tuscany, Marco brought out bowls of hot pasta. He told us that a wild pig (to destroy) all the pumpkins in his garden the night before, which explained the change in menu. Another guest wondered why he (not / to put) up a taller fence around the vegetable patch. Marco shrugged and replied that he (may / to need) stronger wire before autumn arrived.
explanation_ru: Происшествие накануне передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple), отрицательный косвенный вопрос с why сохраняет прямой порядок слов, а модальный глагол may после replied переходит в might.

prompt: Cleaning up after the village festival in Romania, Radu chatted with the sound crew. He recalled that a sudden storm (to cut) the power right as the last band began, so the crowd had lit the square with their phones. A young helper asked how the singer (to finish) the song without microphones. Radu smiled and insisted that the organisers (should / to include) an acoustic finale the following year.
explanation_ru: Событие до момента рассказа и вопрос с how требуют сдвига времени назад без did. Модальный глагол should после insisted остаётся без изменений.

prompt: Washing mud off his boots in Wales, Gareth retold the story of the village match. He boasted that his team (to pull) so hard that the thick rope had snapped right down the middle. His neighbour asked (anyone / to break) a bone when both sides fell into the wet grass. Gareth laughed and denied (to fall) first, even though his jacket was completely brown.
explanation_ru: В первом пропуске сдвигается прошедшее действие, во втором строится общий вопрос с if/whether и прямым порядком слов, а после deny нужен герундий (falling / having fallen), а не инфинитив.

prompt: Safely back on shore in Uganda, our teacher Grace told the bus driver about our boat trip. She explained that the engine (to stop) halfway across the lake, forcing us to paddle back with our hands. The driver asked how long it (to take) us to reach the beach. Grace laughed and promised (to buy) us all cold drinks once we reached town.
explanation_ru: Поломка двигателя и вопрос с how long передаются со сдвигом времени назад и прямым порядком слов без did. После глагола promise требуется инфинитив с частицей to.

prompt: Standing outside a library in Copenhagen, Mikkel admitted he had left his bicycle unlocked for two minutes, and the security guard asked ___.
options: him did he remember the colour of the frame
to him if he remembered the colour of the frame
him whether he remembered the colour of the frame
him what was the colour of the bike frame
explanation_ru: После ask дополнение ставится без предлога to, а косвенный вопрос вводится через whether/if с прямым порядком слов (asked him whether he remembered). В остальных вариантах допущены инверсия или лишний предлог to.

prompt: Before the supply truck left the field station in the Andes, Dr Elena told her assistant, 'Label all the leaf samples carefully, and don't forget to check the date on each bag.'
options: Dr Elena reminded her assistant to label all the leaf samples carefully and not to forget to check the date on each bag.
Dr Elena reminded her assistant that he labels all the leaf samples carefully and didn't forget checking the date on each bag.
Dr Elena said her assistant to label all the leaf samples carefully and not forget to check the date on each bag.
Dr Elena asked her assistant if he had labelled all the leaf samples carefully and checked the date on each bag.
explanation_ru: Напоминание и запрет верно переданы схемой remind + дополнение + to-инфинитив / not to-инфинитив. В других вариантах нарушено управление глаголов said/remind или искажён смысл приказа на вопрос.

prompt: Returning from a canal trip in the Netherlands, Grandma told the whole family what had happened on the water. She laughed and said little Bram (to steer) their boat straight into a floating flower shop. Her daughter gasped and asked (the owner / to shout) at them. Grandma added that she had apologised for (to break) two flower pots, and the kind man had even offered (to help) them push away from the bank.
explanation_ru: История объединяет четыре конструкции: сдвиг времени назад (had steered), общий вопрос с if/whether, герундий после предлога в apologise for (breaking) и инфинитив с to после offer.

prompt: Halfway through a training workshop in Osaka, Yumi made the whole room clap. She confessed that she (to enter) the wrong office for her job interview and still got hired. A surprised colleague asked why the manager (not / to notice) her mistake straight away. Yumi explained that the team had needed someone with her exact skills, so they had refused (to let) her go.
explanation_ru: После confessed прошлое событие передаётся через Past Perfect (или Past Simple), отрицательный вопрос с why строится с прямым порядком слов, а после refuse всегда идёт инфинитив с to.

prompt: Near the marathon finish line in Athens, I ran over to hug my friend Aisha. Breathless, she told me that another runner (to step) on her heel at the start, making her lose one shoe. I asked why she (not / to stop) after the first kilometre. She grinned and warned me (not / to copy) her trick, adding that she (will / to tie) a double knot next time.
explanation_ru: Здесь сочетаются сдвиг прошлого события (had stepped), отрицательный вопрос с why и прямым порядком слов, запрет после warn (not to copy) и переход will в would в будущем намерении.
